book.name: ROMA
book.title: IGI PAULO MENE ROMA EMO ENO GAENA

content: Isreli emo bauno mene tumo diyaora nagibo awang sewa.
O ge nigao otao mani nana, Yuda emo otao mani nana iwaing yaese dubo nana mene aratapu nasani awong kotungno Tuwa Bayau eno isa sinona ara.
Awong Tuwa Bayau sou yari sero putoung nasani nowa awiya gosinona amimene sinena. Arata awong nagibo me sisigatinasani aune yero nowa.

Nagibo Tuwa Bayau mene name giro pewayao ayero sinoiya, nagibo awiya sisigatinowa, arare nuka nuyetope iwaing yari sero nagibo zo kau yero nowa. Awong pewayaora nagibo Tuwa Bayau mene tauna awiya awang sero yangduwa ara.
Sao tauyao ge Mose mene gaena awiya butunawe Kristora una atu besugainu aung yena, arare tumo diyaore nonane awiya Tuwa Bayau mene gosinoi pewayero nonane ara.
Mose nung ge zo eyero sero gaena, “Emo zo nung Tuwa Bayaura benaungna atu pewa yari sero sao tauyao gera nagibo etutero nariniya amimene nao tamariniya.”
Arata tumo diyaore nasani pewayaora nagibo auna ge eyero mitiya, “Ning dubo nina mene eyero oko sase, ‘Awe mene uritira witariniye?’ (Awiya witiro Kristo taungno puro wosao ara.)
Nupema dubo nina mene eyero oko sase, ‘Awe mene kowara wosiro baungno magayaora-una babariniye?’ (Awiya Kristo yuno puro witao ara.)”
Ayao okowata, ge bukura atu eyero sero gayao mitiya, “Ge awiya ake atu oko mitiya, awiya begiti nina-unata moko nina-una atu mitiya ara.” Awiya tumo diyaora ge tugata-magata yero nonane aeno sao ara.

Ge sero butunonane auna susuwa eyao era: Ning begiti nina mene “Yesu nung Tuwa nana” ayero sinarinesa, nupema dubo nina mene “Tuwa Bayau mene Yesu magayaora atu uwenu seka yena” ayero iniro taka sarinesa, awiya Tuwa Bayau mene ning sorero puro korayai iwaing yero narinesa.
Noeno oko, name dubo mene iniro taka sinasani pewayero nonane. Nupema begiti mene yazo nuna keregatinasani iwaing yero nonane ara.
Ge gayao zo eyero mitiya, “Nung tumo diyarineya amimene oko dubo minarineya, o meng oko garineya.”

Yuda emo aune emo Yuda oko aune name awiya Tuwa Bayau mene oko gagausinoiya. Nung dekaongka mene name apakana auna Tuwa naname noiya ara. Name nung yau sinonane auna nung abena name eno mono iwaing tapunasani nona benaung giti pugatinoiya.
Noeno oko, ge gayao zo eyero mitiya, “Zo nung Tuwa yau sariniya nung awiya Tuwa mene soreuno kora yariniya.”

Arata Tuwa yau sao awiya Tuwa oko tumo diyao nowa amimene nono yero nung yau sarinei? Nupema Tuwa Bayau tumo diyao awiya ge nuna dawong mene oko nigao nowa amimene nono yero nung tumo diyarinei? Nupema ge nuna nigao awiya bowi sao emo nuna aung siya, awiya nono yero ge nuna nigarinei?

Nupema bowi sao awiya Tuwa Bayau mene emo oko tugata yero iyengtao yai, nono yero bowi saora burora babarinei? Ge gayao zo eyero mitiya, “Bowi Iwaing sao emora te bewing mene ge nigaora dubo eo yao tapunoiya ara.”
Yuda emo bauno mene Bowi Iwaing awang sewa.
Arata emo bauno apakana oko, ena mene gege Bowi Iwaing awiya nigiro dimuwa ara. Yesaya mene eyero sena, “O Tuwa, nae bowi ge nina sero keregaingwane, awiya awe mene iniro taka seni?”
Arare eyero gipu. Tumo diyao awiya Bowi Iwaing nigaora me ara. Nupema Bowi Iwaing awiya Kristora ge me susuware keregairo sao ara.
Arare eyero sinasani atata nena. Awong ge oko nigao yewita? Aung ara. Awong ge nigiwa ara. Auna ge gayao zo eyero mitiya,

content.text: Be nunae-una bewing mene tawing apakana teng yena. Ge nunae mene tawing sero sero kasa yena ara.

content: Na nupema atata yero sinena. Isreli emo bauno awong ge nigiro susuwa sisigairo kau yewita? Aung ara. Gitau Mose mene Tuwa Bayaura ge zo eyero gaena,

content.text: Na emo Yuda oko puro kora yana niye dubo mou awong eno yarineya. Emo Yuda oko awong nigao aung awiya yumana aune niye awong eno tini kapao pumarineya.

content: Mose mene gitau ayero senu aune ago Yesaya mene awang yao aung be tau yero Tuwa Bayaura ge zo eyero sero gaena,

content.text: Na oko kau yao yewa amimene na tamuwa ara.
Na oko kotumao nasani nauwa nunae-una atu

content: Arata nung Isreli emo bauno eno ge eyero gaena,

content.text: Na ge dao emo bauno o dung duware nao emo bauno awiya yumana nana-una bumaya kora yari sero be imoko-kaungkaung wawong garuru yero diya mitona.
